description:
Activate Mirage Mirror by paying {2}, causing it to become a copy of Storm-Kiln Artist until end of turn.
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Storm-Kiln Artist and Mirage Mirror each trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve Chain Lightning, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter, and causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, targeting Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter, Storm-Kiln Artist, and Mirage Mirror each trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing 3 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist and Mirage Mirror triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 4.
